title: Code of Virginia, Title 55.1 (Property and Conveyances), Chapter 12 - Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act
verified_how: fetched https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title55.1/chapter12/ (HTTP 200): heading 'Chapter 12. Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act', article heading 'Article 1. General Provisions' listing s 55.1-1200 (Definitions), 55.1-1201 (Applicability of chapter; local authority), 55.1-1202 (Notice), 55.1-1203 (Application; deposit, fee, and additional information) and 55.1-1204 (Terms and conditions of rental agreement; payment of rent; copy of rental agreement for tenant) onward to s 55.1-1262; no section marked 'Repealed'. Currency: the register's own 2026 Updates page (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodeupdates/) states 'this is a list of updated sections that took effect on July 1, 2026, unless otherwise noted', so the online Code reflects the 2026 session. The site marks future text as '(Effective <date>)' and dead text as 'Repealed', and the cited provisions carry neither marker. Note that article-level URLs such as /vacode/title40.1/chapter3/article2/ return HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content pane, so the citable register page for an article is its chapter page, which prints the article heading and its section list.
notes: A HUMAN SHOULD NOTE that many sections of this chapter appear in two dated versions on the register, '(Effective until July 1, 2027)' and '(Effective July 1, 2027)' - including ss 55.1-1202, 55.1-1203 and 55.1-1204 - so a 2027 amendment package is already codified. Version selection matters for any encoding. General consumer protection is the separate Title 59.1 ch. 17 (Virginia Consumer Protection Act); only one statute may be listed per topic, so the tenancy statute is listed here.
